description: Farsight Drive adds a secretive Eridani biotech faction to the Persean Sector, bringing living crystal ships, experimental karma-driven hullmods, unusual weapons, relief fleets, charter offices, and lore-heavy encounters tied to the Reflecting-Light Crystal and Farsight’s sealed archives.
